title: Constitution amendment: raise max_tests 60 -> 70 and refresh the stale baseline
description: PR #9 (TS-19) was blocked by the repo's own tmx gate: 61 tests > max_tests 60, and +9 vs a baseline still at the adoption count of 52 (TS-13 and TS-14 added 8 regression tests without refreshing .test-baseline.json). The gate judges PRs by the base policy, so the amendment lands as its own PR first (Article XIII).

acceptanceCriteria.text: test-policy.toml max_tests raised with an amendment log row naming the reason
The .test-baseline.json refresh is from a real JUnit run of the current dev suite
The gate passes on this PR

finalSummary: Amendment 2: max_tests 60 -> 70, with a reason row in the TEST-CONSTITUTION.md log. The TS-13 and TS-14 evaluation work added 8 regression tests for real defects, used up the adoption headroom, and left the baseline stale. .test-baseline.json was refreshed to 60 from a JUnit run of the dev suite. The gate passes locally against origin/dev. It lands before TS-19 because PRs are judged by the base policy. Delivered in the PR that closes this task.
